title: Hormuz GKG share z>1.5 leads USO 1-3d
hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] GDELT Hormuz GKG share 20d z-score > 1.5 leads US crude ETF returns higher by 1-3 days (+) as shipping-risk headlines reprice oil before EM equities; trade long USO 3d [gdelt.gkg.hormuz_share -> finance.USO.log_return] (parent: R2-0088)
message: Not supported: Hormuz GKG share z>1.5 vs USO returns r=0.09 at lags 1-3d (n=390, perm p=0.066); best lag 7d is negative r=-0.22, trade rule only 3 trades - no tradeable edge

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.hormuz_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long USO next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 7 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
